_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "muscles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "seed_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "user_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_modified" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "image" TEXT NULL, "measure" TEXT NOT NULL, "seed_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "user_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_modified" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_muscles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "muscle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES muscles (id), "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES exercises (id), "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "load_units" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" REAL NOT NULL, "decimals" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_builtin" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weights" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "measured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "achieved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "load" REAL NULL, "unit_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES load_units (id), "reps" INTEGER NULL, "seconds" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "programs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_session_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "program_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES programs (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "session_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_reps" INTEGER NULL, "target_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "is_max" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_max" IN (0, 1)), "load" REAL NULL, "unit_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES load_units (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "session_id" TEXT NULL, "session_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "paused_at" TEXT NULL, "paused_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_activity_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_exercise_id" TEXT NULL, "rest_ends_at" TEXT NULL, "rest_total_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "plan_snapshot" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_s" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "swapped_from" TEXT NULL, "from_plan" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("from_plan" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "workout_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_reps" INTEGER NULL, "target_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "is_max" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_max" IN (0, 1)), "planned_load" REAL NULL, "planned_unit_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES load_units (id), "reps" INTEGER NULL, "seconds" INTEGER NULL, "load" REAL NULL, "unit_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES load_units (id), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX exercise_muscles_exercise ON exercise_muscles (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX body_weights_measured_at ON body_weights (measured_at)
CREATE INDEX personal_records_exercise ON personal_records (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX sessions_program ON sessions (program_id)
CREATE INDEX session_exercises_session ON session_exercises (session_id)
CREATE INDEX planned_sets_session_exercise ON planned_sets (session_exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX workouts_status_started ON workouts (status, started_at)
CREATE INDEX workout_exercises_workout ON workout_exercises (workout_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_exercises_exercise ON workout_exercises (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX workout_sets_workout_exercise ON workout_sets (workout_exercise_id)
